name: postgres
description: Read-only access to a PostgreSQL database through the official Model Context Protocol PostgreSQL server. Run ad-hoc SQL, list tables, describe schemas, inspect indexes and foreign keys, sample rows, and analyze query plans — all enforced as read-only at the server protocol level.

interface.shortDescription: Query any PostgreSQL database through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The PostgreSQL skill exposes the official @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres server as a single Fractal toolset. It connects to any Postgres instance over a standard postgresql:// DSN (managed services like Neon, Supabase, RDS, and Cloud SQL included) and surfaces read-only tools for ad-hoc SQL, schema exploration, table/column introspection, and query-plan analysis. All queries run inside a server-enforced READ ONLY transaction, so the agent can safely inspect production data without risk of accidental writes. The toolset is open-source third-party (MIT) and maintained by the Fractal team for the registry.
defaultPrompt: Use the PostgreSQL skill whenever the task involves querying, exploring, or describing a Postgres database — including running ad-hoc SQL, listing tables, inspecting schemas, or analyzing query plans.
Always fetch the live schema for every referenced table before writing a query — column names and types must come from the database, not from memory.
Keep result sets bounded with `LIMIT` and use `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)` for query-plan inspection.
